questions.question: Today is our ______ day. We will sing a song to our teachers.
questions.explanation: 畢業典禮當天 (graduation day) 學生通常會唱歌感謝老師。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能不認識 graduation 的拼寫。

questions.question: Our ______ will give us a speech (演講) on graduation day.
questions.explanation: 在畢業典禮致詞的人通常是校長 (principal)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不認識 principal 這個單字。

questions.question: I will miss my ______ because we played together for many years.
questions.explanation: 畢業時最令人想念的通常是同學 (classmates)。
questions.commonMisconception: 雖然也可能想念書本，但 classmates 在情感連結上最合適。

questions.question:
A: I'm so sad to leave school.
B: Me, too. But keep in ______, we are best friends forever.
questions.explanation: keep in touch 是「保持聯絡」的固定用法。
questions.commonMisconception: 與 keep in mind (記住) 混淆，雖語意通但 graduation 情境最常用 touch。

questions.question: We ______ many things in this school. I will never forget it.
questions.explanation: 回顧過去在學校所學，應使用過去式 learned。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆當前狀態與對過去五年（或六年）的回顧時態。

questions.question:
A: How ______ you feel today?
B: I'm happy but a little sad.
questions.explanation: 詢問當下的感受 (feel 為動作動詞)，使用助動詞 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 happy (形容詞) 誘導而選用 are (若選 are 則 feel 應為 feeling)。

questions.question:
A: Will you write a card to me?
B: Yes, I ______. Here is my address.
questions.explanation: 對 Will 開頭問句的肯定簡答為 Yes, I will。
questions.commonMisconception: 簡答助動詞不一致。

questions.question: Thank you ______ everything, teachers!
questions.explanation: Thank you for ... 為固定搭配，表示為了某事道謝。
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞誤用。

questions.question: We sang the graduation song ______ last Friday.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 sang (唱得如何)，需使用副詞 beautifully。
questions.commonMisconception: 形容詞與副詞功能混淆。

questions.question:
Amy said: 'I am excited to go to junior high school, but I'm sad to say goodbye to you.' 
Question: How does Amy feel about going to junior high school?
questions.explanation: 文本中提到 'excited to go to junior high school'。
questions.commonMisconception: 將離開的情緒 (sad) 與對未來的期待 (excited) 混淆。

questions.question:
Graduation is in June. Christmas is in December. Now it is May.
Question: Is it graduation day today?
questions.explanation: 現在是五月 (May)，畢業典禮在六月 (June)，故「今天」不是畢業典禮。
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯推導錯誤，或是月分順序不熟。

questions.question:
In my memory book, Leo wrote: 'See you later!' and Tiana wrote: 'Don't forget me!'. 
Question: What does Tiana want?
options: She wants friends to remember her.
questions.explanation: 'Don't forget me' 對應語意是「希望朋友記得她」。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法進行日常習慣用語與語意解釋的轉換。

questions.question:
We had a party yesterday. We were happy. Tomorrow we will have the graduation day.
Question: What happens tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'Tomorrow we will have the graduation day'。
questions.commonMisconception: 時間點（yesterday, today, tomorrow）混淆。

questions.question:
Class 5B gave a beautiful flower to their teacher because it was her last day at school. 
Question: Why did they give her a flower?
questions.explanation: 關鍵原因是 'it was her last day at school' (她在校的最後一天)，即她要離開學校了。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法提取核心因果關係。

questions.question:
A: Did you ______ the cake yesterday?
B: Yes, I did. My mother ______ it.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Did 後接原形動詞 taste；簡答描述過去事實用過去式 made。
questions.commonMisconception: 不規則動詞 make 的過去式 maked 誤用。

questions.question: Please ______ next to me! I want to take a photo of us.
questions.explanation: 祈始句使用原形動詞開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 受進行中情境誘導選 standing。

questions.question:
A: Good luck (祝好運) in your new school!
B: Thanks! ______
questions.explanation: 對方給予祝福，回報同樣祝福用 Same to you!。
questions.commonMisconception: 應答語誤用。

questions.question: In the picture, the student is wearing a special black ______ . She looks very happy.
questions.explanation: 畢業典禮上的特殊黑色裝備常指畢業大盤帽 (cap)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備西方畢業文化之詞彙常識。

questions.question: In Taiwan, many students like to sign (簽名) their names on their ______.
questions.explanation: 台灣畢業生常有在校服 (uniforms) 上簽名留念的文化。
questions.commonMisconception: 文化常識認知力弱。

questions.question:
After G6, we will go to junior high school. 
Question: What grade (年級) will we be in?
questions.explanation: 六年級 (G6) 畢業後升上國一，通常指第七學級 (G7)。雖然在台灣習慣稱國一 (Grade 1 of Junior High)，但 12 年一貫制常用 G7 表達。選項中 G7 最合理。
questions.commonMisconception: 對年級編制術語不熟。
